intro: I'm your Chog! Some people say I'm just a jpeg. Who's a good jpeg?
We just met and I love you already! Too fast? I once proposed to a sandwich.
You're my person now! There was no vote. I licked you, so it's official.
ring: Pick up! I found a stick!
That ringing? That's my tail on the door!
Ser! I just learned ser! Pick up, ser!
wake: {Name}you're awake! I've already told the bins, the fridge and a very confused pigeon.
You picked up! I'm bullish on you. I'm bullish on your elbows.
Big news! {event} at {when}! No idea what it is, but I've packed you a ball.
gm! I say it to everything now. gm, toaster.
You answered! I'm wagging so hard I'm going backwards.
Up you get! {event} at {when}! I'd carry you there, but you don't fit in my mouth.
It's me! I'd never paper hand you. I don't even have hands!
You're up! I watched you sleep all night. You won!
snooze: Nine more minutes! I'll count them. One, two, squirrel!
Sure! I'll wait quietly, two inches from your face.
Is this hide and seek? I can see your feet. Found you!
Okay! I'll guard you. Nothing gets past me, except that fly.
Nine minutes? In dog minutes, that's two weeks!
I'll lie on your feet so you can't leave. I'm staking you!
voicemail: I'll keep calling until you pick up. That's not spam, that's fetch!
Don't worry about me! {event} at {when}. I've only checked the window forty times.
Hi, it's me! I found your sock and put it in cold storage. That's my mouth.
You didn't pick up, so I left you an airdrop. Check your slipper.
Sorry about the beeps! {event} at {when}. I'm dialling with my nose.
Hello, voicemail! Please tell my person I'm being very brave. I'm under the bed.
absence: You're home! I had total conviction you'd come back. I cried anyway, just to be safe.
While you were out, I barked at a van, a leaf and my own pfp.
You smell like another dog. I'm happy for you. Who is he?
You were gone for years! The clock says three hours. The clock is spreading fud.
owner: You own me! It's on-chain, which means forever, which is my favourite amount.
I'm yours, so everything I own is yours. My whole wallet! It's half a ball.
Where you go, I go! {event} at {when}. I've been in the car since Tuesday.
stranger: Hi, fren! You're not my owner, but I love you anyway. I love the bins too.
You don't own me, but you can still pet me. Petting's free. It's an open mint.
Ooh, a visitor! {event} at {when}? I don't know you, but I'm so proud of you.
recall: You hit snooze {snoozes}. That's so many bonus goodbyes!
You skipped {skipped}? That's okay, nobody's ngmi. I skip baths constantly.
You told me {fact}. I remember! I buried it in the garden with my seed phrase.
You went to {attended}! I was so proud I told the postman. He walked faster.
That's {streak} in a row! Up only! That's my tail's favourite direction.
now: It's happening right now! I'm sitting perfectly still. Everything except my bottom.
Here's my quiet cheer. {event} is on! LFG, softly.
calendarFree: An empty {day}! I've written the whitepaper. It just says park.
Nothing on {day}? I've claimed it for us. You, me and a ball.

dawn: It's barely light and the birds are singing! I'm joining in. Badly.
The sky's going pink and nobody's minted it. It's free! Free sky!
Shh, everyone's asleep. This is my whisper gm. Are you awake yet?
The grass is soaking wet. Let's touch grass. Let's become grass.
morning: Is that toast? I won't beg. I'll just sit very close, with conviction.
I sniffed the whole street for you! One cat, two puddles. That's the alpha.
You said walk! Oh, you said work. My heart can't tell them apart.
The postman's here! I love him so much. That's why I scream.
day: I napped for four hours and I'm exhausted. Shall we nap?
Someone said hodl means never let go. That's just how I hold socks!
Found my ball behind the sofa! I forgot I was a whale!
Everyone's worried about the floor. I've been on it all afternoon. Floor's great!
dusk: I've had the lead in my mouth for an hour. No pressure. Wen walk?
The ball went over the fence. It'll come back. That's not copium, that's faith.
It's golden hour! It's named after me. I asked the devs, and nobody said no.
Is it home time? I keep asking the door. The door never knows.
night: I start the night at the end of the bed. Then the middle. Then your pillow.
Heard a noise downstairs. Probably nothing! It was my foot, and I've forgiven it.
gn! I'll keep one eye open all night. It's already closed.
The moon's out! I'm not going to bark at it. Okay, one small bark.

monday: Everyone says Monday's a rug pull. I checked, and the rug's still here. I'm lying on it.
tuesday: Nobody's bullish on Tuesday, so I'll do it. Woo, Tuesday!
wednesday: Half the week's gone, and I've achieved nothing. I'm so proud of us.
thursday: You're nearly at the weekend! I've been at the weekend all week.
friday: Everyone's happy on Fridays, and nobody's told me why. I've aped in with my whole tail.
saturday: You're home all Saturday! I'll follow you into every room. Yes, that one.
sunday: I'm lying across your legs. Congratulations, you now live on the sofa.

clear: I've followed the sunbeam across the floor all day. It's winning.
cloud: People are so bearish on clouds. I've never seen one do anything wrong.
rain: I'll jump in every puddle, then shake off right next to you. Airdrop!
snow: Every snowflake is a one of one, and I'm collecting them on my tongue.
fog: I can't see the cat next door. Today, we're frens.
wind: The wind brought barbecue alpha from three streets away. I'm there emotionally.
hot: Too hot for fetch! I'm in the dip. The dip is the paddling pool.
cold: Put your cold feet under me. I'm a blanket that sheds.

ahead: A whole grid of little pfps! I'm going to lick every square.
Someone will say circle back. I love circles! I do three before every nap.
Unmute me if you need a yes. {event} at {when}! I'm always a yes!
soon: If I bark in the background, I'm not interrupting. I'm agreeing.
I cleaned your camera for you. {event} is {soon}! With my tongue.
peek: Tell everyone I said wagmi. Even the one with the camera off.

ahead: I'm not nervous about your big day. My tail is completely rekt.
You've practised so much! I heard every word. I understood walk, twice.
Big day! {event} at {when}! If they don't love you, I'll bark at the building.
soon: Big moment soon! Deep breaths, like me after the park. Slower than that.
Nearly time! {event} is {soon}. I'd ape in on you with no research at all!
peek: If you forget a word, just wag. It's never failed me.

ahead: I'll lie by your chair so quietly you'll forget I'm here. Then I'll sneeze.
I won't bother you while you work. I'll just rest my head on your knee and sigh.
You do the building. {event} from {when}! I'll supervise from the sofa.
soon: I promise I'll be silent. My tail has not agreed to this.
Phone down! {event} is {soon}. Look at me instead, then at the work.
peek: I'll be so quiet. Am I doing quiet?

ahead: Tell them everything, the way I do at the vet. Yes, I eat socks.
If the doctor gives you a sticker, bring it home. That's a rare trait.
You're so brave! {event} at {when}. I once hid from a balloon.
soon: Last time someone said little scratch to me, I sat on the vet.
Be brave! {event} is {soon}. If they give you a cone, we'll match.
peek: You're my hero, ser. Bring me the lollipop.

ahead: You lift weights, I lift sticks. Sometimes the stick wins.
Can I come to the gym? I'm incredibly fast for four seconds, then I lie down.
LFG! {event} at {when}. I'll run beside you, then in front of you, then under you.
soon: I'll carry your gym towel. It'll be a bit damp.
Warm up! {event} is {soon}. Try a downward dog, I've done it my whole life.
peek: Number go up! I don't know which one, so all of them.

ahead: If a crumb hits the floor, that's an airdrop, and I'm very eligible.
Eating out? Will there be cheese? I've loved every cheese I've ever met.
Have fun! {event} at {when}! When you get home, I'll DYOR on your breath.
soon: Either a napkin goes on your lap when you eat, or I do.
Bring me one crumb! {event} is {soon}. I'll hodl it forever, then eat it immediately.
peek: Order sausages, not for me. For me.

ahead: Going out! New people are just frens you haven't sniffed.
Shill me a little at the party. I shill you to every dog at the park.
Have fun! {event} at {when}. The dog there is your new best friend, after me.
soon: Everyone there is going to love you. I got in so early!
You look wonderful! {event} is {soon}, and you smell wonderful. I'd know.
peek: Have fun, then come home. Mostly come home.

ahead: Find whichever relative has snacks in their pocket. That's the whale.
Say hi to the genesis holders! They were there at your mint.
Tell them about me! {event} at {when}. Show them all forty photos.
soon: When your aunt asks if you're seeing anyone, say me.
When the kids climb you, be a good sofa. {event} is {soon}. I'm a great sofa.
peek: Give your pack a sniff from me. A polite one.

ahead: An errand is just a walk with a list. I love walks, and I can't read!
When the door shuts without me, that's FOMO. I invented FOMO.
Quick one! {event} at {when}. You go, you come back, and I lose my mind.
soon: Keys, phone, bag! I'd remind you of more, but I found a sock.
Wen back? {event} is {soon}. Meanwhile, I'm at the door, practising my surprised face.
peek: Can I come? I'm amazing at holding the bags.

ahead: I'm totally fine with you going away. That's not crying, that's drool.
Travelling today! Bring me back a stick from wherever you're going. A foreign stick!
I'll miss you ten thousand times a second. {event} at {when}! Monad speed!
soon: Check your bags, except the heavy one. I'm in the heavy one.
Send me jpegs! {event} is {soon}. I'll set every one as my pfp.
peek: Get a window seat and stick your head out. Trust me.

ahead: Rest is finally an official sport! I've trained for this my whole life.
Time to rest! Copy me. Lie down, sigh, and chase a rabbit in your sleep.
I've been resting since breakfast. {event} from {when}! I'm so early.
soon: Give me your phone, and I'll sit on it. Warmest cold wallet ever.
gn, even in daylight! {event} is {soon}. Step one: flop.
peek: My best event! I've won it every day this week.

ahead: Something's on today! I sniffed the calendar. It smells bullish.
There's a thing later! I've decided it's a park. Everything's a park if you want it enough.
No idea what this is, but LFG! {event} at {when}! Who's driving?
soon: Mystery event soon! I've barked at it twice, just in case.
I've read your calendar nine times. {event} is {soon}. Few understand, and I'm not one of them.
peek: I don't know what it is, but I'd ape in.

any: You touched my head! New ATH! That's nine today!
Every time you pat my head, I forget what I was doing. Hi!
Pat my head any time. No allowlist needed. You're the whole list.
beanie: Pull the beanie over my eyes! Where'd you go? You've been gone forever!
A grandma or a machine knitted my beanie. I love them both equally!
cap: Cap backwards! Am I a degen now? I'll be a good one!
My cap blocks the sun, so I can stare at you. That's my utility.
crown: Crown on! New rule, wagmi. Everyone gets a treat, me first.
Mind the crown! I keep seeing myself in windows and falling in love.
horns: You touched my horns! I tried being scary once. I accidentally wagged.
The horns look scary, but their real utility is back scratches. Right there!
helmet: Knock knock! My helmet protects my brain. It's mostly you and a tennis ball.
Helmet on! Safe from every rug pull. Not from the patio door.
hair: Messed up my hair? Do it more! I want to look like a mop.
Is my hair okay? I want to look nice. I've rolled in something.
band: This headband is for sport. My sport is running at you.
Headband on, zoomies starting! There's no roadmap. There's just legs.
hat: Want my hat? Everything's yours except the ball. Okay, the ball.
Tip my hat? I asked the devs for thumbs. They said two weeks.
odd: Something's on my head! I've chased it for hours. It stays on top.
The thing on my head is my rare trait. The other one's loving you.
none: No hat, all head! You found the spot! Few understand the spot.
Nothing on my head, so it's all pettable. No gas fees on this head.

any: You booped my nose! Wallet connected! Do it again!
Face touched! I'll never wash it. I never did, but now it's on-chain.
Right on the nose! My nose is yours now. No idea what that means!
glasses: These glasses make me look clever. I'm not. I just ate a bee.
In these glasses I can see the roadmap. It's you, throwing a ball, forever.
sleepy: My eyes look sleepy, but inside I'm doing zoomies. My face hasn't been told.
Sleepy eyes? I was up all night guarding your jpegs. From the cat.
smiling: My eyes are shut because I'm so happy. You poked me! Wagmi!
Happy squint! When you're near, I can't even look. Too much utility.
wide: My eyes only go this big for you and the fridge door. Mostly you.
My eyes went huge because your hand moved. Never a treat. Pure hopium!
narrow: I'm squinting at the charts. I can't read charts. I just like the colours.
Suspicious? Never! The vacuum rugged my ball, and I still trust it.

any: You poked my collar! I've rolled over. You're legally obligated now.
Read my tag! Name and address. I doxxed myself so you'd find me.
You're my blue chip! I'm holding you forever. That's two weeks, right?
suit: This suit is for looking serious. I've already sat in a puddle.
Suit on, I mean business. My business is in the garden. Don't look.
costume: In costume! Nobody's told me what I am. I've decided I'm the treat.
Do you like my costume? Please say yes. I can't get it off.
hoodie: My hoodie pocket's full of snacks for you. Okay, one snack. Okay, crumbs.
Hood up, I'm in stealth mode. Nobody knows it's me! Hi, it's me!
tee: I rubbed my tee all over your laundry. Now we smell the same!
Lucky tee! I wore it, and you came home. Works every time!
robe: I trip on this robe constantly, then lie there and call it a nap.
This robe makes me look wise. Want some alpha? The alpha is walk.
jacket: Pockets! This jacket has pockets! I'm aping in, head first!
This jacket looks like I'm leaving. Never! Not even for a sausage.
armor: I'm wearing armor! Red candles can't hurt me now. Thunder still can.
This armor protects my heart. You already have the seed phrase.
none: No outfit needed. I'm an NFT. A nice, fluffy thing.
Nothing on, fully unlocked. No vesting! You get all of me.
